CustomField.label: Node Key
CustomField.description: Logical node identity — the field a future history feature queries by. Capped at 80 chars (vs. 255 on the live OI_Graph_Node__c table) because this field participates in OI_Graph_Node_Archive_Idx, and Big Object indexes cap combined text-field length at 100 characters total — a platform limitation documented in the Sprint 7 deliverables report, not an oversight. Node keys longer than 80 characters remain stored in full on the live table; only this archive copy is length-constrained.
